description: Chief Secretary's Office - S.P. - Published the Co-operative Employees Pension Scheme Precept of the Southern Provincial Council
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the establishment of a new legal/regulatory framework - the Co-operative Employees Pension Scheme Precept for the Southern Provincial Council. It outlines the legal provisions for creating a pension scheme, defines the legal character of the corporation, establishes administrative structures (Director and Advisory Committee), and specifies operational procedures. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it creates new regulatory requirements and statutory instruments rather than focusing on government personnel changes or organizational structure.
